jobs.occupation: Nexin - Medior / Senior BizTalk and .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established Belgian logistics and distribution company operating nationwide with multiple sites across the country.

The organization manages time-sensitive distribution flows and supplies thousands of retail points daily. As part of its strategic evolution, the company is expanding into new product categories while modernizing its IT landscape.
The environment combines

• A stable SME culture with flat hierarchy

• Long-term employee retention

• High operational criticality

• A strong ongoing digital transformation program

To strengthen the internal IT team, our client is looking for a Medior / Senior BizTalk & .NET Developer (minimum 5 years of experience).
Your role

You will join an experienced internal IT department (infrastructure + development) and actively contribute to the evolution of business-critical applications.

You will:

•  Design, develop and maintain integrations using Microsoft BizTalk Server 2020 and C#/.NET.

• Create and maintain schemas, MAPS, orchestrations, pipelines, ports and adapter configurations.

• Develop .NET components, services and REST/SOAP integrations; work with XML, XSD, XSLT and JSON.

• Write and optimize SQL Server queries and stored procedures, and implement validation, error handling and logging.

• Translate business requirements into technical solutions with business analysts and application owners.

 

Day to day support

• Monitor interfaces and application health; investigate failed exchanges, suspended messages and processing delays.

• Handle daily support requests and production incidents, prioritize business impact and keep users informed.

• Diagnose issues across BizTalk, .NET, SQL Server and connected systems; coordinate resolution with IT teams and external partners.

• Restore processing safely, including controlled message resubmission, and investigate root causes to prevent recurring incidents.

• Maintain support procedures, runbooks and incident records; turn recurring problems into permanent improvements.

 

Quality and delivery

• Test integrations and .NET changes, including failure scenarios, and contribute to code reviews.

• Manage source code in GIT and support deployments with environment-specific configurations and rollback procedures.

• Document interfaces and technical changes, and share knowledge with colleagues.

You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and operational teams. As a BizTalk and .NET developer, you will work in tandem with another colleague
Work environment

• Multicultural team

• Flat organizational structure

• Short decision-making lines

• Strong collaboration culture

• Fun culture

• On-site presence in Belgium required (with homeworking)

• At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, including proven experience developing and supporting Microsoft BizTalk and C#/.NET solutions, ideally with BizTalk Server 2020.

• Strong C# and .NET Framework skills, with hands-on experience in Visual Studio.

• Practical knowledge of BizTalk messaging, routing, promoted properties, MAPS, orchestrations and pipelines.

• Experience with XML/XSD, XSLT, JSON, REST/SOAP services and adapters such as sFTP and WCF-SQL.

• Solid SQL Server skills and experience troubleshooting integration or application issues in production.

• Experience with GIT, testing and structured deployment practices.

• Ability and willingness to combine development work with daily application support.

• Proven use of AI tools in software development, such as coding assistants for implementation, testing, debugging and documentation, with critical review of generated output and respect for data confidentiality.

• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a good working command of English.

 

Additional assets

• Experience with SAP integrations, EDI/AS2 or other enterprise systems.

• Knowledge of modern .NET, ASP.NET Core, Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus or API Management.

• Experience with CI/CD, PowerShell, monitoring tools, or Jira and Confluence.

• Knowledge of Broadcom Automic for scheduling and monitoring automated jobs and workflows.

 

Soft skills

• An analytical mindset and a methodical approach to troubleshooting.

• Ownership of issues through to resolution, with clear communication and a focus on business needs.

• Ability to manage priorities calmly, collaborate with colleagues and document solutions clearly.

• Portfolio Development & Business Growth     
• Develop and expand the company's product portfolio within specialty chemicals.   
• Identify new products, suppliers and market opportunities based on customer needs and market developments.   
• Build business cases for new product groups and assess their commercial potential.   
• Leverage your existing industry network to establish new supplier relationships and unlock additional business opportunities.   
• Proactively identify opportunities to expand the company's market presence and generate additional revenue.      
• Strategic Procurement & Supplier Management     
• Develop and execute procurement strategies aligned with the company's growth ambitions.   
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with international suppliers.   
• Lead commercial negotiations on pricing, payment terms, delivery conditions and contractual agreements.   
• Monitor global raw material markets, pricing trends and supply risks.   
• Identify alternative suppliers and products to improve competitiveness and supply reliability.      
• Commercial & Financial Management     
• Work closely with Sales to identify customer needs and translate these into portfolio opportunities.   
• Monitor purchasing costs and market developments and translate these into competitive selling prices.   
• Set and review monthly sales price levels for different products.   
• Identify opportunities to improve gross margins and overall profitability.   
• Contribute to the development of new business through strong supplier and market relationships.      
• Operational & Supply Chain Management     
• Oversee purchasing activities and ensure timely replenishment of inventory.   
• Balance stock availability, customer service levels and working capital.   
• Monitor supplier lead times and delivery performance.   
• Support demand forecasting and inventory optimization.   
• Drive continuous improvement in procurement processes and reporting.     
  
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Chemistry or equivalent experience.  
• 5–10 years of experience in procurement, sourcing or portfolio management.  
• Strong experience in the chemical industry and an established network of contacts within this industry, with the ability to leverage these relationships to create new business opportunities.  
• Proven experience in international supplier management and commercial negotiations.  
• Strong strategic, commercial and analytical skills, with a good understanding of pricing, margins and inventory management.  
• Hands-on, entrepreneurial and proactive mindset, with the ability to work independently.  
• Fluent in English; Dutch and/or French are a plus.

An organization primarily funded by the government of Belgium, it supports scientific research across various disciplines, providing grants and fellowships to researchers and scholars. It plays a crucial role in advancing knowledge and innovation within the country, contributing to scientific progress on both national and international levels.

Jobomschrijving

Job Function

The hired individual will be attached to the International and Institutional Affairs Department – Mobility and Congress, primarily responsible for administrative management of the department.

Tasks

Administering the management of the department's email inquiries and secretarial tasks.

Processing various documents.

Providing administrative support to team members.

Receive briefings and requests for content creation from the various stakeholders in the organisation

Plan the copy work and communicate clear deadlines to the stakeholders, taking into account potential back-and-forth and validation.

Create content in line with the Thalys tone of voice and internal processes, taking account of SEO constraints

Ensuring that the content is validated by the various stakeholders before being sent to the translators

Reviewing the content once it has been translated and integrating it into our CMS according to the production process

Bachelor's degree in administration

Proficient written and spoken English (minimum B2 level)

Minimum 2 years of experience in administration

Excellent spelling and grammar

Ability to analyze and synthesize information

Organizational skills, attention to detail, dynamism, adaptability to priorities, and flexibility

Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team

Proficiency in computer tools (MS Office)

Knowledge of the academic and research world
